question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
What is your favorite part about New Year's Eve?
Do you fulfill all your New Year's Resolutions?

nodes.text: Angie and Hannah wrestle for the last chicken suit.
Angie tugs hard and pulls away with the suit in hand...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Got it!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Not again!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's my girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Now go put it on before anyone gets any ideas...
A few minutes later...
At Hector's house...
Students in formal wear and various costumes can be seen en masse on the front lawn and through the windows.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It looks like everyone came.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: And, Miss... That is an excellent dress.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Still would've been more awesome if we'd matched.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sorry, $Scott...

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Oh! Those are... Interesting feet.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: They were supposed to be part of a chicken suit...

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: That would have been a sight to see...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: L'Amour it is!
A couple minutes later...
Angie and $Scott walk through the restaurant L'Amour.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Good evening! Welcome to L'Amour.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Look, I have enough to do without you pestering me about it. We don't have any tables right now, but one will come up. Eventually.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And hi, Angie. Your outfit is.... Okay.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I wanted her to match.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's a shame. I'm sure that look would've been perfect for her too.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I know, right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, $Scott... Great, uhm, feet.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's part of my chicken suit. Angie helped pick it out for me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It shows.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Bananabee's it is!
A couple minutes later...
$Scott and Angie walk into a loud and busy restaurant. Cheerleaders and football players mill around the entrance, waiting for a table.
Taylor and Maria approach on their way out.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So where are we going for dinner?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm still trying to figure out where we should go. I consulted my restaurant index where I coded all the restaurants by town region and categorized them by specific quality.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's... Neat. But that means what exactly?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I know all the restaurants around us by location, price range, attire, wheelchair accessibility, caloric content...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wow, okay. Let's go with what's closest.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Let's see... The two closest restaurants are...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: L'Amour is old but romantic, and it's where all the students go when they have date nights...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But Bananabee's is where all the popular people go to hang out and eat on Friday nights and...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Bananabee's?! I heard that restaurant's awesome!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: They're known for their delicious bananas foster.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Their waiters even juggle flaming torches and use them to caramelize the bananas.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: So you want to go to Bananabee's?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No. I just heard other students talking about it. But it's your night, and I trust you. Where do you think we should go?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It might cheer $Scott up to see people and have an enormous dessert, but L'Amour definitely has the better atmosphere.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Let's go to...
A few minutes later, Angie emerges from the dressing room wearing the yellow dress!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I don't know about this. I feel ridiculous. It's just so... `Bright yellow.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know about this. I feel ridiculous. It's just so... [color=#3b78e2][i]Bright yellow.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And I think I'm allergic to these feathers.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I think you look great!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And we look really great together.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: When you put it that way, I guess I can't complain.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But I hope it'll be really dark wherever we go!
After paying for all their items...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Costume shopping was way better than my original plan.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: To mope around your house until Hector's party?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I just wanted to tell you that I feel better.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Great! Then you'll really like the next phase of our date.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Which is?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Dinner!
A few minutes later, Angie emerges from the dressing room wearing the black dress!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, I was kind of hoping we could match...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But you do look really nice.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But maybe I should've gone for the yellow dress anyway.
After paying for all their items...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I think costume shopping went well, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It was better than my original plan.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: To mope around your house until Hector's party?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Maybe the next phase of our date will cheer you up more then...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And that is?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Dinner!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But what are you going to wear?
Angie sticks her hand in a rack and pulls out an old-fashioned black dress.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: This?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You could wear that...
$Scott pulls out a bright yellow dress with a gigantic feather collar from another rack.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Or you could wear this.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yellow's not really my color.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, but it would match me.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What do you say?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: He'll be happy with the yellow dress, but I'm going to look ridiculous!
Hannah smacks Angie's hand away from the chicken suit!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Owwww!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Hah! It's mine! Don't get in the way of a star...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Or you'll end up losing an eye.
Hannah stalks off.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm fine. But drama people are intense... I'll have to find something else.
A few minutes later, after scouring the racks of clothes...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I can't find a chicken suit, but I did find these cool, awesome bird feet you can wear...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I can't wear the bird feet without the feathers. It feels wrong.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's close enough... Go put it on.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You tell me. What's something we can do today that you've always wanted to do?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's New Year's Eve. Maybe there's still a resolution left from last year that you didn't fulfill?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I did everything on my list... I think.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You made a list? That doesn't sound like you.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, you made one for me. Here, let me check.
After some digging, $Scott pulls out a crumpled paper from his desk.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Let's see... I threw the best party ever. I crashed a college party. I ate five buckets of fried chicken in three hours...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh no! You're right, Anj. I forgot this last one! I wanted to dress up as a chicken at a party!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: A chicken?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You know, as a tribute to all that chicken I ate.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You want to dress up as a `chicken` on the last day of the year?
nodes.text_bbcode: You want to dress up as a [color=#3b78e2][i]chicken[/i][/color] on the last day of the year?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I was going to do it for Halloween, but `somebody` decided to get all vampire-crazy. Not naming names... But it wasn't me. And they're in the room.
nodes.text_bbcode: I was going to do it for Halloween, but [color=#e23b3b][i]somebody[/i][/color] decided to get all vampire-crazy. Not naming names... But it wasn't me. And they're in the room.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But this is my last resolution. I can't believe I forgot to do it!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, the year's not over yet.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I don't know if we'll be able to find a chicken suit that easily...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But we'll make this work.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We need to dress up for Hector's party anyway. Let's go to the mall.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: To the mall!
A short time later...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I called the Party Superstore on our way over, but no one seems to be answering the phone.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'd quit worrying about it.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Who wants to borrow a chicken suit on New Year's Eve anyway?
$Scott and Angie approach the store...
And walk straight into the middle of a consumer war zone!
Costumes fly through the air, and girls tear at items on the shelves!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This store is a disaster!
In front of them, a fight breaks out!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Hannah, dear... Sometimes you just have to. Let. Things. Go!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: That... That chicken suit's mine, Mona! I grabbed it first!
Hannah and Mona struggle until Mona emerges victorious. Hannah stalks off angrily.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Mona, what is going on?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: It's marvelous! There's an emergency audition for the lead of the new school musical.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But why is everyone going after chicken suits?!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: The musical is 'My Fair Chick,' the famous musical where a professor trains a flower seller to act like royalty?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Isn't it supposed to be 'My Fair...'?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: It's a modern day production, darling. And this is method acting. To truly become a character, one has to step into her shoes... Or talons.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Hence, why the actresses are all aflutter getting their feathers.
Mona wanders off.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What was she talking about?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I don't entirely get it, but I know if you want a chicken suit, we need to get in there now!
Angie scours the clothing racks until finally...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I found the last one!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: That one's mine!
Angie tightens her grip on the suit as Hannah makes a dive for it! They struggle for the chicken suit.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: She's `really` strong... Better put my back into it...
nodes.text_bbcode: She's [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] strong... Better put my back into it...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's a sweet gesture, but... I don't know if that'll cheer me up exactly.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No offense, but the last time you planned a date, we just did calculus homework.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But it was a calculus study date.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...I'm not even in calculus.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: So maybe that wasn't my best plan.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But it'll be different this time! It'll be an entirely not-me date! We'll do whatever you want.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Like not go to Hector's party?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, you have to go. You said you would, and you're the President, so it's important that you remain visible.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But before that, we'll do all the things you want to do!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I can help you with that. $Scott, we'll do something more fun than prepping a party.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: So we have to show up at the party you wanted to throw that Hector beat you to.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Before that, we'll do our own thing, and it'll be great.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'll call you 'El Presidente' once.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Twice, and deal!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We'll do all the things you want to do, El Presidente.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You're just asking us now? Shouldn't you send these invitations out more than a day in advance?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on, $Scott, no one plans more than a day ahead. You know that.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm just saying...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So we'll see you there? Won't be a school party without the President, right?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Of course we'll be there.
$Scott closes the door as Hector's horse-drawn carriage clip-clops off.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: There go all my 'awesome' plans. Hector and Amanda have the carriage invite, the themed party, and the student body... They even have a fog machine!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but I've been out-partied!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's not too late to try to out-party them.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I can't do that. New Year's is special to them.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But I was planning on spending the entire day prepping for tonight. Now I'm not sure what to do with myself.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's okay...

options.label: I'll plan out a better day for us!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm a little confused. Is it a costume party or a masquerade? Because those are two totally different things.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Does it matter? Come dressed up!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And aren't you forgetting proper party etiquette?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, how could we forget about that and also what that means?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm always forgetting something. One time I forgot it was my birthday... I saw the name on all the presents, and I couldn't wait to meet the other Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I was so sad that I hadn't brought a gift!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You didn't forget anything, Amanda... The party is fine.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh! Good!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What Angie's trying to say is that the party sounds so complicated that it's going to be a lot of fun.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, no one's complained about one of my parties yet.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So will you two be able to make it?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Good snacks, bubbly drinks, a live band, a fog machine. That sounds like a lot of fun!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! It does sound like a lot of fun!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott thinks so too, right?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Er, yeah! Thanks for saying exactly what I was thinking, Angie.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So you'll come?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You didn't send out invites? Shouldn't those go out more than a day in advance?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No one plans more than a day ahead.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'll just invite everyone now through text message, and the party will happen.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Listen to this text. 'Centerscore students, your President commands that you celebrate this awesome New Year's Party of Awesome-ness!'

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That sounds... Awesome? Shouldn't it have more information?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's in the next text. I'm hitting 'Send'! Ready?
Before $Scott can hit the button, there is a loud commotion from outside!
Angie and $Scott run to open the front door.
Outside, Hector appears in a Victorian costume as he steps out of a fancy horse-drawn carriage.
Amanda, dressed in a ball gown, takes his hand as he helps her step down.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hector? Amanda?
Hector pulls out a large scroll, unfurls it, and reads...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hear ye, hear ye, citizens of Centerscore! Come one, come all to my `awesome New Year's Eve Masquerade Ball!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hear ye, hear ye, citizens of Centerscore! Come one, come all to my [color=#e23b3b][i]awesome New Year's Eve Masquerade Ball![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wear your finest livery... Partake of the fancy bubbly drinks, the delicious snackages...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Breathe in the fresh, foggy air of my fog machine...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And dance and throw down to a real live band!
Hector hands out impressively large paper invitations with fancy fonts and bright pictures.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Whoa, these are... Beautiful! So perfectly symmetrical...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, they look good, man.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, listen, it's great you want to throw a party, Hector, but I also want to...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This isn't just a party! It's a celebration!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: New Year's Eve is a really special time for Amanda and me.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Last year, I threw an entire party a whole week late just so I could get a kiss from her. This year, I want to celebrate that I can kiss her every single day.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Aww, Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So in honor of our relationship, this will be `the` New Year's celebration to end `all` New Year's celebrations.
nodes.text_bbcode: So in honor of our relationship, this will be [color=#e23b3b][i]the[/i][/color] New Year's celebration to end [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] New Year's celebrations.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Everyone's coming so far. So what do you think?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott's speechless! I should help him out! But what do I say?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It sounds...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: If you really want to know...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Of course I do.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Have you thought about logistics? Where are you going to put the food and the drinks?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Who's in charge of the music? Where are you going to set up your dance floor?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And have you thought about crowd control?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I, uh, er... Hadn't thought about any of those things!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But you're right! I'm glad you brought all that up. What would I do without you?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Lose all your paperwork and forget the function of the Student Council?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, probably. Thanks for always thinking of how to make things better, Anj.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That's what I'm here for. To organize your life.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And that's one of the things I like best about you.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott, that's so sweet!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'll figure out all those things later, though.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: For now, the only thing we need to worry about is guests.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That does sound like a party that won't get you into trouble.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And I think the student body will have a lot of fun. It'll probably move popular opinion of you higher on the polls.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm glad you think so, but...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What's wrong with the party?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I just told you it sounds great!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, but you never sign off on these things without asking me a ton of questions first.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I was just trying to be supportive.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: If you really want some feedback, you could work on some logistics...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, I'll figure all that out later.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But for now, the only thing we need to worry about is guests.

nodes.title: New Year's Date
nodes.subtitle: Can you help Angie make New Year's Eve special?

nodes.text: It's New Year's Eve, and $Scott and Angie are planning $Scott's epic New Year's party!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This is going to be an awesome party, Angie. The party to end all parties!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: When you say it like that, it makes me a little nervous. Are you sure about this?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What's not to be sure about?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: We have snacks... Salsa, chips, soda... And don't get me started on music!
$Scott gestures to his boombox sitting in the corner, underneath piles of compact discs.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And for my last surprise...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Please tell me it's not a snow machine.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's better! It's a `fog machine!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's better! It's a [color=#e23b3b][i]fog machine![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So be honest. What do you think?
Angie weaves through the crowd with $Scott in tow to find...
Angie trips through the crowd as passersby bump and jostle her.
$Scott gets lost in the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Scott? Scott?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie! Over here, near the Obadiah statue!
Angie stumbles over to where $Scott is.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sorry, $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You sure you just don't want to stay here? From this statue, I can kind of see the ball drop... Or maybe that's the moon, I can't tell.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Come on, let's just get a little closer!
Angie pushes through the crowd and finds...
A few minutes later, in the car...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's almost midnight. You didn't want to stay at Hector's party?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We just had to drop by the party. But I've got an even better place for us to go now.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Where to now?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Centerscore Square. You can't have New Year's without getting to see fireworks and the ball drop, can you?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Just tell me where to go.
A short drive later, $Scott parks on the outskirts of the square.
A huge crowd of people cluster around a tower, where a large sparkling ball glitters from the top of a long needle.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This is great!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You haven't seen anything yet. We need to get to the center.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But there are a lot of people...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Get ready to bob and weave!
Angie pulls $Scott forward into the throng!
Angie walks over to the drink table and puts a hand on $Scott's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I'm not $Scott, but I can be...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ryan?!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: The one and only. You're cute. Want to celebrate that midnight make-out session a little early?
Ryan leans in.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ewwww, no way!
Angie quickly backs up into the drink table and flips over it!
Angie and the drinks fly everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie?!
$Scott rushes over from the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah. Are you? After what everyone's been saying about Hector's party, I thought...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What have people been saying?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Er, nevermind that. Come on, let's get out of here.
Angie pushes $Scott out the door before he can protest.
Angie walks onto the dance floor and puts a hand on $Scott's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott?
$Scott takes Angie's hand, twirls her and dips her!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You look like you're in a good mood.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm just glad you dragged me out of the house, Anj. This day really was a lot of fun in the end.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ready for one last surprise?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: There's more?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Of course! Come on, let's get out of here.
$Scott and Angie leave the party.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: If I know $Scott, he's by the...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: So, to conclude, let's raise our glasses...
Angie raises her glass.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: To our friend and President, $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: To $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: To $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: To $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: To $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: See how much everyone appreciates you?
$Scott kisses Angie!

nodes.speaker: Scott

...The woods?!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Wait, where are we?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Weren't we just in Centerscore Square?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Maybe, but I must've taken a wrong turn somewhere?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What happened to your coded regional maps or whatever?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Those were for restaurants! Not parts of the city we're most likely to get lost in!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...`Those` maps are at home!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...[color=#3b78e2][i]Those[/i][/color] maps are at home!

nodes.text: From a short distance away, a bush rustles.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Did you hear that?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I didn't want to.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No, don't panic. It's okay. The woods behind Centerscore are perfectly safe. The worst we can run into is like a...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...Rabid... Raccoon.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Aghhhh!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott? I didn't know you were that afraid of raccoons..

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Not that... Bear... Behind you!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: Growl...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Run!
$Scott grabs Angie's hand and sprints through the woods!
A small pack of bears rushes forward to give chase!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: RAWR!
$Scott and Angie are lost in the woods, being chased by bears?!
This isn't the great New Year's ending either of them would have wanted!
Try again and see if you can make $Scott and Angie's New Year's more special than a life-or-death run through the woods!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You look like the most handsome... Guy in yellow chicken feet I've ever seen.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Not quite what I was going for, but...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Close enough.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You look like the most handsome chicken I've ever seen.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I do make this yellow suit look good.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Oh! What a wonderful costume!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: That's a very handsome chicken suit...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: And, Miss... Uh, it looks like a dead bird has fallen onto your dress?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Actually that's part of my outfit...

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Oh! I'm sorry... I...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's okay...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, $Scott... Great chicken suit.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie helped pick it out for me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It shows.
Taylor looks over and sees Angie.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And, uh, Angie. You look...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Doesn't she look great?
Taylor suddenly bursts into laughter!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ha ha ha ha! I... I just can't.. Feathers... Chicken coop...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There are too many jokes to make right now...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm glad this makes $Scott so happy...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But I don't want to be laughed at!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Look, I have enough to do without someone who looks like they've been tarred and feathered pestering me about it.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: We don't have any tables right now, but one will come up. Eventually.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Great chicken suit! Wasn't that your New Year's resolution?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah. Have to make that last resolution before the ball drop tonight.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, this certainly counts!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And wow, Angie, you look so... Fluffy.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...I'm supposed to be a chicken.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Not just any chicken. She's my chicken.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: How hard can it be to find someone in a chicken suit?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: How hard can it be to find someone wearing bright yellow chicken feet?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Happy New Year, El Presidente!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You remembered!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Like I ever forget anything.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: From the legs down, at least.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dressed up like a chicken for me...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Took me to a great restaurant we should totally go to again...
In fact, just like Angie's date with $Scott, you were perfect! Here's a bonus scene!
$Scott and the leaders of the Student Council convene.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: First Student Council meeting of the year has officially begun. President?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Thank you, Secretary. For my first act as President of the Student Body in the New Year...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: We should set goals to better ourselves as men and to improve the general conditions of the school.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And that means setting forth resolutions.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What kind of resolutions?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What would you like to see happen in the school?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Reimbursible tanning sessions for all the cheerleaders during the season.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Didn't you say that it was important to better ourselves? Everyone knows that self-improvement begins with a perfect tan!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Come on, the cheerleaders are the representatives of the school.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's not quite what I had in mind...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Objection!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This isn't a court-room.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: If the cheerleaders get to fry themselves, the nerds should be able to do that as well.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You want to tan?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What? And ruin this pale complexion? No!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But you just said...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We want paid luxury buses to all future Quiz Bowls.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: As the `real` representatives of the school, we need to be able to travel in comfort.
nodes.text_bbcode: As the [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] representatives of the school, we need to be able to travel in comfort.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Wait just a minute! What about my group?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: We're the 'real representatives'! Activities like Auto Club and theater involve far more students than just the popular kids and the nerds!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You are `all` representatives of the school!
nodes.text_bbcode: You are [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] representatives of the school!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I was asking about what we wanted to improve. Things like school spirit or morale.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is about morale. Mine! And the cheerleaders need to look their best.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: It would raise our spirits if we didn't have to bike to our own tournaments.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And what about Auto Club?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Secretary, can we strike this conversation from the record and forget it ever happened?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Striking and forgetting, Mr. President...
Looks like $Scott has an interesting year ahead of him!
See you next year on Surviving High School! Happy New Year!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And when did you change into a chicken suit?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Never mind that. You already know I'm the school Secretary. Why...
